block.name: NeuroGraph: retire ng_experience_tract.py — migrate callers to ng_tract directly
acceptance_criteria: neurograph_rpc.py: no import of ExperienceTract; _drain_tract() uses inline atomic-rename + ng_tract.TractReader logic
neurograph_gui.py: no import of ExperienceTract; deposit calls use ng_tract.deposit_experience() directly
neurograph_mcp.py: no import of ExperienceTract; deposit call uses ng_tract.deposit_experience() directly
python3 -m py_compile passes for all three files
Changes committed and pushed to greatnorthernfishguy-hub/NeuroGraph

never: Do not modify ng_tract (the Rust crate) or any vendored file
Do not modify ng_experience_tract.py — delete it
Do not change the drain protocol logic (atomic rename, TractReader loop, JSONL fallback)
Do not import new top-level dependencies
anti_drift: Three targeted changes per file: (1) remove ExperienceTract import/init, (2) replace deposit() calls with ng_tract.deposit_experience(), (3) inline drain logic in neurograph_rpc.py _drain_tract(). Nothing else.

steps.description: Replace deposit_experience tool body: remove _get_tract() call, use ng_tract.deposit_experience() directly

params.old_text:
try:
        tract = _get_tract()
        tract.deposit(
            content=content,
            source=source,
            content_type=content_type,
            metadata={"via": "mcp", "timestamp": time.time()},
        )
        pending = tract.pending_count()
        return f"Deposited. Tract has {pending} pending entries awaiting drain."
params.new_text:
try:
        import ng_tract
        ng_tract.deposit_experience(
            content=content,
            source=source,
            tract_path=_LEGACY_TRACT_PATH,
            content_type=content_type,
        )
        return "Deposited. Entry queued for drain on next afterTurn."
